description: Monitoring data from Mill Hill pile stabilised railway embankment is a data set deposited in University of Southampton Repository by its authors Joel Smethurst. Dataset supports: Smethurst, J., Bicocchi, N., Powrie, W., & O'Brien, A. S. (2019). Behaviour of discrete piles used to stabilise a tree-covered railway embankment. Géotechnique, [18-P-150R1].A data set from the monitoring of a pile-stabilised railway embankment at Mill Hill, between November 2004 and July 2010. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
